description: This file defines a websocket connection manager for a real-time application, managing room-based WebSocket connections with presence tracking using FastAPI's WebSocket and asyncio constructs.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: A websocket manager that handles connecting, disconnecting, broadcasting, and presence tracking within room-based structures.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the ConnectionManager with an empty rooms dictionary and an asyncio lock.

methods.name: None connect(self, room: str, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Accepts a websocket, adds it to the specified room, and broadcasts presence join message.

methods.name: None disconnect(self, room: str, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Removes a websocket from a room and broadcasts presence leave message.

methods.name: None broadcast(self, room: str, message)
methods.description: Sends a message to all websockets in a room, closing any websockets that raise exceptions during sending.

methods.name: int count(self, room: str)
methods.description: Returns the current number of websockets connected to a specified room.

ctags.name: broadcast
ctags.pattern: /^    async def broadcast(self, room: str, message) -> None:$/

ctags.name: connect
ctags.pattern: /^    async def connect(self, room: str, websocket: WebSocket) -> None:$/

ctags.name: count
ctags.pattern: /^    async def count(self, room: str) -> int:$/

ctags.name: disconnect
ctags.pattern: /^    async def disconnect(self, room: str, websocket: WebSocket) -> None:$/
